sources.snippet: Gemma is a family of open-weights Large Language Model (LLM) by Google DeepMind, based on Gemini research and technology. This repository contains the implementation of the gemma PyPI package. A JAX library to use and fine-tune Gemma. For examples and use cases, see our documentation.
